def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    used = max_cap - bins
    new_fill = (used + item) / max_cap
    efficiency_reward = np.where(new_fill >= 0.8, 2.0 * new_fill, 1.2 * new_fill)
    scrap_penalty = 1.5 * np.exp(-(((rem - 0.1) / 0.05) ** 2))
    scores[valid] = efficiency_reward[valid] - scrap_penalty[valid]
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty = np.argmax(is_empty)
        non_empty_valid = ~is_empty & valid
        max_non_empty = np.max(scores[non_empty_valid]) if np.any(non_empty_valid) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = max_non_empty - 0.5
    return scores

        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    empty_mask = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    tight_mask = valid & ~empty_mask
    if np.any(tight_mask):
        scores[tight_mask] = 1.0 / (rem[tight_mask] + 1e-7)
    if np.any(empty_mask):
        first_empty = np.argmax(empty_mask)
        scores[:] = -np.inf
        scores[first_empty] = np.max(scores[tight_mask]) * 2.0 if np.any(tight_mask) else 1000.0
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    used = max_cap - bins
    new_used = used + item
    fill_score = (new_used / max_cap) ** 2
    tightness_penalty = np.exp(-2.0 * rem)
    scores[valid] = fill_score[valid] - 0.2 * tightness_penalty[valid]
    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty = np.argmax(is_empty)
        max_non_empty_score = np.max(scores[~is_empty & valid]) if np.any(~is_empty & valid) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = max_non_empty_score - 0.5
    return scores

    used = max_cap - bins
    fill_ratio = used / max_cap

    sigmoid_rem = 1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-10.0 * (rem - 0.2)))

    is_empty = (bins == max_cap) & valid
    if np.any(is_empty):
        scores[np.argmax(is_empty)] = 0.45
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    rem = bins - item
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf, dtype=float)
    valid = rem >= 0
    if not np.any(valid):
        return scores
    max_cap = np.max(bins) if len(bins) > 0 and np.max(bins) > 0 else 1.0
    is_empty = np.isclose(bins, max_cap) & valid
    non_empty = valid & ~is_empty
    
    if np.any(non_empty):
        used = max_cap - rem[non_empty]
        ratio = used / max_cap
        scores[non_empty] = np.cos(np.pi * (1.0 - ratio)) - 5.0 * np.exp(-10.0 * rem[non_empty])
        
    if np.any(is_empty):
        first_empty = np.argmax(is_empty)
        best_ne = np.max(scores[non_empty]) if np.any(non_empty) else 0.0
        scores[first_empty] = best_ne - (1.0 + 2.0 * (item / max_cap))
        
    return scores
